summary: Iter 139 regression + feature check: Twilio webhook signature verification (POST /api/twilio/inbound + /api/twilio/status) now correctly rejects missing/invalid signatures with 403 and accepts correctly-signed requests (200/204). Core backend endpoints (login, /api/team/sizes, /api/roster) have no regressions. Frontend: Sizes download chooser modal, Roster '...' actions menu, and AddTypeModal (schedule/new) all open and their primary action buttons are visible/tappable; CSV + XLSX downloads trigger file downloads on web (cheerplanner-sizes.csv/.xlsx and cheerplanner-roster.xlsx). Settings Danger Zone 'Delete Account' and Team 'Have a team code?' entry could not be exercised on the web preview (native Alert.alert does not render on react-native-web, and the demo account is Owner so the join-code button is hidden by design) — this is not a product bug, just a web-preview test limitation.
action_items: No fixes required. All iter-139 feature flows verified where testable on web.

Note for native QA (iOS/Android): manually confirm Settings → Delete Account → Continue reveals the password modal with testID 'settings-delete-confirm-btn' (web preview cannot drive react-native Alert.alert).
Note: 'Have a team code?' entry (testID 'team-join-code') is hidden for Owners by design; to retest, log in as a non-owner member or create a secondary account.
critical_code_review_comments: core/twilio_verify.py correctly skips verification when TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN is unset (dev) and enforces when set — safe default.
twilio_hooks returns 403 Response (not raise HTTPException) which is fine for a webhook; keeps the response body empty.
Sizes CSV/XLSX export is built client-side via exportAoa — rows include name, role, and all size columns in the user's current column order (matches spec).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on testable flows (3/3 verified; 2 skipped as not web-testable or hidden by role)
